CURRICULUM VITAE - Robert E. Drake

EDUCATION:

I received a B.S. in Electrical Engineering in 1970 at Mississippi State University. I completed my Ph.D. in physiology under Aubrey E. Taylor at the University of Mississippi Medical School in 1975.

ACADEMIC APPOINTMENTS:

1975 Instructor, Department of Anesthesiology, The University of Mississippi Medical Center, Jackson, Mississippi.
1976-1977 Assistant Professor, Department of Anesthesiology, The University of Mississippi Medical Center, Jackson, Mississippi.
1977-1980 Assistant Professor, Department of Anesthesiology, The University of Texas Medical Branch, Galveston, Texas.
1980-1988 Associate Professor, Department of Anesthesiology, The University of Texas Medical School at Houston, Houston, Texas.
1988-Present Professor, Departments of Anesthesiology, and Physiology and Cell Biology, The Univ. of Texas Medical School at Houston, Houston, Texas.
